title: Best-effort background live location sharing with PWA support and updated transparency copy

requirements.summary: Enable best-effort periodic live location updates while the app is backgrounded, and clearly communicate limitations when closed/unsupported without changing backend-controlled enabled state.
acceptanceCriteria: When a child enables Live Location Sharing, the app continues attempting periodic location updates while the page is backgrounded (e.g., another tab/app is in front) without requiring the user to keep the page focused.
If the platform/browser does not support continuing execution after the app is closed, the UI communicates that limitation clearly (i.e., no misleading promise of always-on background sharing).

Live Location Sharing state remains controlled by the backend flag (useGetLiveLocationSharingStatus / useSetLiveLocationSharing) and is not silently toggled off just because a capture attempt failed locally.

file_operations.description: Refactor live sharing to be resilient in background-tab scenarios: use best-effort scheduling (including Page Visibility awareness) and/or geolocation watch mode as appropriate, avoid stopping local sharing attempts on transient capture/submit failures, and decouple UI 'actively capturing' status from the backend-enabled flag so failures do not imply the backend toggle changed.

Add a small capability-detection utility to determine whether the current browser context is likely to keep running in background tabs and whether it can support PWA/service-worker assistance; return a concise status that the UI can use to show accurate limitations messaging.

Implement a lightweight, permission-respecting queue for pending location updates (e.g., when offline or when submission fails) so the app can retry later; ensure queueing only happens when Live Location Sharing is enabled via the existing toggle.

Update the Live Location Sharing panel to: (1) show background/closed-app limitations based on capability detection, (2) show a clear 'best-effort' status when enabled even if a recent capture fails, and (3) avoid implying the feature turned off unless the backend flag is disabled.

Adjust parent-side live sharing description text usage to align with best-effort background behavior and potential closed-app limitations (e.g., clarify that updates may pause depending on the child's device/browser).

requirements.summary: Add installable PWA support with manifest + service worker registration and implement best-effort background-capable queuing/retry mechanisms where available, with clear fallbacks when unsupported.
acceptanceCriteria: The frontend includes an installable PWA manifest and registers a service worker from the React app entry flow (without modifying any immutable paths).

Where supported by the browser, the app uses a background-capable mechanism (e.g., service worker + background/periodic sync) to queue and/or submit location updates when Live Location Sharing is enabled.
On browsers that do not support background/periodic sync, the app falls back to foreground/background-tab operation only and shows a clear status/notice.

file_operations.description: Create a PWA manifest declaring app name, start_url, display mode, theme/background colors, and icons referencing frontend/public/assets/generated/pc-logo.dim_256x256.png.
Add the generated logo asset at the required path so it can be referenced by the web app manifest.

Create a service worker that supports app-shell caching and (where available) background sync triggers for retrying queued location submissions; keep behavior safe and permission-respecting by only acting on queued updates created while the user had explicitly enabled live sharing.
Add a small registration helper that registers the service worker, reports support/registration status, and exposes helpers to request background sync/periodic sync where supported.

Wire service worker registration into the React app bootstrap flow (after initial render) using the new registerServiceWorker helper; ensure it does not rely on immutable paths and fails safely on unsupported browsers.
Link the PWA manifest and add any required meta tags (e.g., theme-color) so the app is installable and provides correct PWA metadata.

Integrate queueing/retry signals for PWA/background support: when live sharing is enabled, enqueue failed submissions for later retry and (when supported) request a background sync trigger so queued updates can be retried with the UI closed.

requirements.summary: Update user-facing copy (EN and pt-BR) and transparency/policy text to accurately reflect best-effort background behavior and platform limitations.
acceptanceCriteria: English translations are updated for Live Location Sharing helper text so it no longer claims sharing only works while the app is open (e.g., update liveLocationActiveInfo, liveLocationForegroundNote, and parent-side live sharing description).
Portuguese (pt-BR) translations are updated to match the new meaning.
The Transparency & Policies content is updated so it does not incorrectly state the app 'Does NOT collect data in the background' when background live sharing is enabled by the child.

file_operations.description: Update Live Location Sharing strings to reflect best-effort background operation (backgrounded tabs) and clearly state limitations when the app is fully closed or the browser restricts background execution; update liveLocationActiveInfo, liveLocationForegroundNote, and liveLocationParentActiveDescription accordingly, and adjust transparencyNotDoL2 so it no longer incorrectly claims no background collection when live sharing is enabled.

Update pt-BR Live Location Sharing strings to match the updated English meaning (best-effort background behavior + clear closed-app limitations), and adjust the Transparency & Policies copy so it no longer incorrectly states that the app does not collect data in the background when the child has enabled live sharing.

Ensure the Transparency & Policies UI presents the updated translation content without implying unconditional background tracking; if needed, adjust section ordering/emphasis to keep consent and limitations clear while still matching existing translation keys.

Update helper/notice copy usage in the Live Location Sharing panel so it aligns with new translations and emphasizes explicit opt-in, best-effort behavior, and platform limitations (no misleading always-on promise).
